However, its capital structure is highly leveraged, with total liabilities of 17,381M relative to shareholders' equity of 3,328M (resulting in a debt-to-equity or leverage ratio of over 5x and an equity-to-assets ratio of approximately 15%). This significant leverage, common among regulated financial institutions or highly geared utilities, balances its strong profitability and asset base to position it in the lower-tier investment grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
